segments.intent: Count job postings mentioning both R and data visualization as requirements
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS jobs_with_r_and_data_visualization FROM scout_postings WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%r%' AND (LOWER(COALESCE(description, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%')
```
